description: An ASP.NET Core application is one process that serves many concurrent requests, so static fields and singletons are shared across all of them until the process stops.
The C# compiler checks types before the program runs and rejects mismatches that PHP would only detect, or silently coerce, at call time.
A shared set of threads that runs request code in .NET, so a thread blocked on I/O reduces capacity for every other request.
Services, configuration and endpoints are registered in C# code read top to bottom, instead of being merged from XML files of many modules.
A module-closing exercise built locally with the .NET 10 SDK and self-checked against acceptance criteria, because the app has no C# runtime.
A dated section that holds facts which age, such as versions, support dates and licence changes, with the date they were checked.
